research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: DroneDeploy is researching methods and systems for automatically classifying reality capture data, improved aerial mapping with aerial vehicles, adaptive mission execution on unmanned aerial vehicles, and generating a unified tile pyramid from orthomosaics. These areas focus on processing, classifying, and managing aerial data captured by UAVs, as well as optimizing mission parameters and data delivery for cloud-based mapping and analytics.

overview_description.description:
DroneDeploy develops reality capture, robotics, and artificial intelligence software that helps organizations collect, manage, and analyze visual data from construction sites, infrastructure, industrial facilities, and other physical assets. The company provides cloud-based applications for drone mapping, 360-degree image capture, autonomous robotics, digital twins, progress tracking, asset inspection, and site documentation. Its platform integrates aerial drones, ground robots, 360-degree cameras, mobile devices, and design data to create a unified record of field operations and support project monitoring throughout the asset lifecycle.

DroneDeploy also offers artificial intelligence capabilities for automated progress measurement, quality assessment, safety monitoring, defect detection, and analytics that enable teams to identify issues and make operational decisions using visual data. The company's technology integrates with enterprise software, geographic information systems, building information modeling tools, and project management platforms to support collaboration across engineering, construction, energy, agriculture, and infrastructure workflows.
